log.msg: Built Servex/ext/openrouter/evals/models.mjs: reads results.jsonl (rule tests + probes, newest line per model x effort x test) plus public/framework/ai/tests/*/page.jsonl (empty today, wired for minion-test-library's AITest library), writes public/framework/ai/system/models/models.json. Weighting (Phase 11): performance is the weighted mean of each run's credit (falling back to great=1/ok=0.5/fail=0, or the existing pass boolean/array, when a run has no credit yet), weighted by each test's weight = discrimination (Spearman rank correlation of the test's credit against each model's mean credit on every OTHER test) x confidence, floored at 0, defaulting to 1 (unweighted) until there are >=4 models' worth of runs to compute discrimination from.

Added the Models page (public/framework/ai/overview.js: SYSTEM_PARTS + pages['models']/pages['thinking'], the pattern the existing claude-md part already uses rather than a separate page.js). One chart (three small-multiple facets, one per kind, since rule-adherence values run 5-80 and the probe values run 0-0.5 -- a shared axis would crush the small ones), one combined table, one best-value line per kind. 'How thinking works' is a sibling page with one picture (provider-server vs our-machine) plus the four Phase 10 token-spend points, each linked to Anthropic's extended-thinking docs and OpenRouter's reasoning-tokens docs, and a note on where OpenRouter differs (not every upstream provider exposes raw thinking text).

Smoke-tested headless on a private port (4567) at 400/1200/1920/3440: both pages render, chart scales with viewport, table and best-value lines all show, no server errors.
